english.title: Causes / permits nuisance / disturbance on educational premises - ENGLAND
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were without lawful authority on the premises of,

(A)_[an institution (other than a school) maintained by a local authority and providing further or higher education, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF INSTITUTION..)]_
(B)_[an institution within the further education sector, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTITUTION..)]_
(C)_[a 16 to 19 Academy, namely **(..SPECIFY ACADEMY..)]_

and caused or permitted a nuisance or disturbance on those premises, to the annoyance of persons lawfully using those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85A(1) of the Further and Higher Education Act 1992.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 85A(1) details the premises that are covered for the purposes of the offence including playing fields and other premises which are used or are being used for the purposes of outdoor recreation.
(ii) Section 85A(3) states that a police constable / other person with the appropriate authority under the legislation may remove any person reasonably suspected of committing or having committed the offence under the section.
(iii) The offence will be made out whether the person to whom the annoyance is caused is present on the premises or not at the time the annoyance was caused.
